images.title: The seconds hand from 3 to 8
images.purpose: A seconds dial with a ghost hand on 3 and a red hand on 8, the stretch between them shaded, and 40 − 15 = 25 seconds written beside it.
images.composition: A caption at the top, one seconds dial with a ghost start hand, a red stop hand and a shaded stretch between them on the left, and the working written at the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LEFT: the caption Remo timed himself tying his shoe in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (36 px), left edge at x 100, about y 70. ONE CLOCK, centre at x 400, y 430: a circle 400 px across (spanning x 200 to 600 and y 230 to 630) with a dark teal #0B3C49 rim 14 px thick and a pale face #E8F4F8; 60 small tick marks around the face in dark #2B2B2B, of which 12 are long (4 px wide, from radius 160 to 180 px, at the 12 numbers) and 48 are short (2 px wide, from radius 168 to 180 px); the 12 numbers 1 to 12 in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (34 px), centred on a ring of radius 138 px from the centre, 12 at the top, 3 on the right, 6 at the bottom, 9 on the left; a small dark #2B2B2B centre dot 14 px across. The clock has no hour hand and no minute hand, only a seconds dial. WEDGE: a pale vermilion #F7D2C0 wedge (no outline) from the centre out to radius 176 px, from the 90 degree line to the 240 degree line, going clockwise from the start hand to the stop hand (150 degrees wide, 150 degrees is 25 seconds), drawn under the hands. START HAND (a pale ghost): a grey #9CA3AF hand 4 px wide and 150 px long, round end, pointing at the number 3 (90 degrees clockwise from 12), its tip at x 550, y 430. STOP HAND: a vermilion #D55E00 seconds hand 5 px wide and 160 px long, round end, pointing at the number 8 (240 degrees clockwise from 12), its tip at x 261, y 510.  RIGHT SIDE, left edge at x 760, in dark bold: two lines at about y 330 and y 400 (40 px): Start on 3 is 15 seconds, then Stop on 8 is 40 seconds. BOTTOM RIGHT, left edge at x 760 and about y 640: 40 − 15 = 25 seconds (56 px), the largest text in the frame. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Each number is 5 seconds: the hand moved from 15 seconds to 40 seconds, so 40 − 15 = 25 seconds.
images.description: A seconds dial with a ghost hand on 3 and a red hand on 8, the stretch between them shaded, and 40 − 15 = 25 seconds written beside it.
images.context: Concept image for Reading the Seconds Hand. It follows the idea of the clock pictures in your maths book (a seconds hand at its start and at its stop) and shows the concept's own example of Remo tying his shoe.
images.teaching_notes: Count the numbers from 3 to 8 in fives with the child: 20, 25, 30, 35, 40. The slip to watch: reading the hand on 8 as 8 seconds.

image_decisions.why: The dial with the start hand, the stop hand and the shaded stretch shows how the seconds taken are read from the numbers.
